lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ),
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → (Fin n → ℝ) → ℝ :=
      fun O v => Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(v ⬝ᵥ ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)) *ᵥ v)) / 2)
    let r : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-(κ + 1 - (κ - 1) * (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0) *
            ‖x‖ ^ 2 / 4)
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n),
      Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O (WithLp.ofLp x)) ((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) ∧
      Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * r O x) ((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) ∧
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * p O (WithLp.ofLp x) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) =
      (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
        (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * r O x ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))))
approved_definition_context: The full real orthogonal group has inherited matrix topology and Borel sigma-algebra, with both determinant signs. Measure.haarMeasure on top is its actual normalized full-group probability; compactness and probability are supplied internally.

EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) carries its actual Euclidean norm. WithLp.ofLp gives its real coordinate vector; it does not replace the norm with a coordinate sup norm. Matrix mulVec and dotProduct use these coordinates.

All local lets are literal formulas. The first index is zero-based and its validity follows from the dimension bound. Real.sqrt is the nonnegative real square root; powers with real exponent (n:R)/2 use real division.

The displayed p and r are explicit real functions, not a constructed probability law or assumed density characterization. Integrable means actual absolute Bochner L1 for the displayed Haar law, and both such assertions are conclusions for every fixed Euclidean vector.
